An AI-powered supply chain compliance engine

We are RetailReady (YC W24) - an AI-powered supply chain compliance engine. We’ve raised $6.6M in funding, onboarded over 50 customers, and in the past 12 months we’ve 4x’d our revenue. We are building world-class software that will disrupt an antiquated industry & we want you on board.

We’re tackling everyday challenges for real people in the supply chain – that’s the heart of every business. With us, you’ll see your work come to life in amazing ways. Imagine being a part of why Walmart can restock baby formula, helping a health & beauty brand go from startup to Target shelves, and empowering warehouse workers with the latest tech. That’s the impact you’ll have.

This isn’t just another job offer - it’s an opportunity to create your own path and make a tangible difference.

What’s cool about retail compliance?

This position is not for the faint of heart - we have ambitious plans for RetailReady, and we want someone who shares the same level of ambition, and has the tenacity & passion to stick with us for the long haul.

We have an in-person team in San Francisco. If you’ve gotten this far and are fired up, reach out.

RetailReady is building an AI-powered supply chain compliance engine. Supply chains are still heavily reliant on paper processes and tribal knowledge, causing costly shipping mistakes that jeopardize the longevity of businesses. RetailReady is the first-to-market with our retail compliance packing software, leveraging camera vision to direct warehouses to ship orders without error. We are positioning our compliance data models to become the operating system that will power the next wave of warehouse robotics and automation.
chineseContent:
人工智能驱动的供应链合规引擎

我们是 RetailReady (YC W24) - 一个人工智能驱动的供应链合规引擎。我们已经筹集了 660 万美元的资金，吸引了 50 多个客户，在过去 12 个月里，我们的收入增长了 4 倍。我们正在构建世界一流的软件，这将颠覆一个过时的行业，我们希望您加入。

我们正在为供应链中的实际人员应对日常挑战——这是每个企业的核心。与我们一起，您将看到您的工作以惊人的方式变得栩栩如生。想象一下，成为沃尔玛补充婴儿配方奶粉的一部分，帮助健康和美容品牌从初创公司走向塔吉特货架，并为仓库工人提供最新技术。这就是你将产生的影响。

这不仅仅是另一个工作机会——这是一个创造自己的道路并做出切实改变的机会。

零售合规有何酷之处？

这个职位不适合胆小的人——我们对 RetailReady 有雄心勃勃的计划，我们希望有人拥有同样的雄心壮志，并有坚韧和热情与我们长期合作。

我们在旧金山有一个面对面的团队。如果您已经走到这一步并且感到兴奋，请伸出援手。

RetailReady 正在构建人工智能驱动的供应链合规引擎。供应链仍然严重依赖纸质流程和部落知识，导致代价高昂的运输错误，危及企业的寿命。 RetailReady 是第一个将我们的零售合规包装软件推向市场的产品，利用摄像头视觉指导仓库准确无误地运送订单。我们将合规数据模型定位为操作系统，为下一波仓库机器人和自动化提供动力。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
